Details: All current metrics and statuses come from the uploaded 21 October consolidated CSVs. Missing older formula/configuration metadata is reused from the 19 October audited configuration table. No earlier metrics replace current scores.

All 304 registrations remain in campaign/case order. Six onset controls are evaluation-only reuses and do not count as new model fits. The historical full-data 250 m fit is shown separately. Incomplete snapshot entries do not prove that a job is currently running or failed.

RMSE is sqrt(mean(per-cast MSE)); each cast has equal weight. Shape RMSE removes profile means. Peak-depth error concerns the raw maximum inside 10–150 m and is more noise-sensitive than sustained onset. Intervals are new-observation predictive intervals, not expected-curve credible intervals.

The main threshold is chl_norm=+0.5, i.e. 50% enhancement; sensitivity thresholds are +0.25 and +1.0. All censoring and inadequate support stay explicit. Pairwise onset errors use observed and both model curves with detected onset on the same casts.

Conditional includes date/ENSO group effects; new levels are sampled under the fitted group distribution. Population sets group effects to zero and does not marginalize a new group’s full variability.

Focused new contrasts use 5,000 reproducible region-stratified bootstraps of Ocean/Region/date clusters, retaining their member casts. Intervals are exploratory, conditional on the sampled cohorts and not corrected for selection.

The review neither refits models nor submits jobs. Observed values and full scores remain intact; omitted-cast comparisons are labelled influence sensitivities only. No missing validation predictions were manufactured.

The harmonized convergence screen uses Rhat<1.01, bulk/tail ESS>=400, no divergences and E-BFMI>=0.3; tree efficiency is reported separately. Passing does not establish adequate biological structure or calibration.

CSV tables, annotated analysis scripts, the archive hash and R figure reproduction code are included in the companion ZIP. The original source archive remains unchanged. The R script is supplied for RStudio and was not run locally.
